name: auth-fetch-mcp
description: MCP server for human-approved reading of authenticated pages in a local browser. Returns readable text or cleaned HTML with source metadata and completeness warnings.

tools.name: auth_fetch
tools.description: Opens a local browser for manual login and Capture page confirmation. Returns text by default, optional HTML, links, media and extraction warnings.

tools.name: download_media
tools.description: Downloads selected attachments using saved cookies. Returns per-file results and optional small image previews.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Lists all open tabs in the browser with their URLs and titles.

tools.name: close_browser
tools.description: Closes the browser and cancels an active capture. Saved login sessions are retained.
